name: AgiBot G2
summary: G2 is AgiBot's industrial wheeled humanoid with a 26-DoF body, two 7-DoF force-controlled arms and NVIDIA Jetson Thor compute. It is built with automotive-grade parts and IP42 protection for assembly, logistics, inspection and guided-tour work.

dof.original: 26 DoF body with 7 DoF force-controlled arms

compute: NVIDIA Jetson Thor, up to 2,070 TFLOPS.
highlights: Dual hot-swappable batteries for continuous operation.
Passed over 130 component tests including -15 C to 50 C trials, per Interesting Engineering.
caveats: AgiBot does not publish height, weight or payload on its product page.
Wheeled base, not a legged humanoid.

sources.title: Agibot launches advanced G2 humanoid for high-precision manufacturing
